doomMeter.label: How f*cked are we?
doomMeter.methodology: Mean of publicly stated p(doom) estimates from named AI researchers. Definitions of "doom" vary by speaker (extinction, catastrophic harm, loss of human control). Personal estimates, not formal forecasts — treat as directional.

experts.name: Dario Amodei
experts.context: Anthropic CEO; Axios AI+DC Summit, Sept 2025

experts.name: Yann LeCun
experts.context: Meta Chief AI Scientist; public statements

articlesOverview: The frontier labs are converging on near-identical reasoning benchmarks — OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google DeepMind now cluster tightly at 93.6–94.3% on GPQA Diamond, with SWE-bench Verified split between coding-tuned leaders (GPT-5.5 at 88.7%, Opus 4.7 at 87.6%) and Gemini 3.1 Pro at 80.6%. xAI and Meta are differentiating on pricing and openness respectively, rather than raw capability.

articles.title: Introducing GPT-5.5
articles.summary: OpenAI's flagship model with improved agentic capabilities and Terminal-Bench 2.0 results.

articles.title: Claude Opus 4.7

articles.title: Gemini 3.1 Pro Model Card
articles.summary: Google DeepMind's flagship: 94.3% on GPQA Diamond, 80.6% on SWE-bench Verified.
